					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text 'I got these for working out and they are great! I’ve had them for about two months and use them 5-6 times a week. The battery lasts forever, I usually only charge once every one to two weeks.'

				time '4/20/23'

What they do, they do OK, also they were fairly easy to pair (wouldn't pair with my S10 the 1st time around, paired well with Tab 6, then paired easily with S10 the 2nd time)I will be keeping them, but will be looking for a better pair for mowing"
				text 'Dibbins'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'Quality'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text 'The media could not be loaded.'
				text 'The sound is good and the quality is good for the price. I will definitely buy again.'
				text 'WillWill'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'So far, so good'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text "Bought for my 11 year old son for remote learning back in August. He says they're comfortable, battery lasts well and they also have a wire in case you forget to charge them. Good price too."
				text 'hrw81'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'Terrible quality'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 20 |'
				text 'This is the second pair of headphones that we’ve purchased and I am returning them again. The fact that I now have to get my car and waste gas for a second time to return 15 headphones that I purchased for my four-year-old grandson is very sad. The problem is you do not wanna spend a lot of money for a four-year-old child however I can’t blame the child this time for any defective condition because it’s not even 30 days that we have the second pair of headphones. Do not waste your time even looking. I’m sure that there are plenty of headphones on Amazon around that price point that are much better quality'
				text 'Amazon Customer'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'not bad and folding is good for travel'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 80 |'
				text "I like that they fold and can get small for travel. These are NOT over the ear cups. I got about half my ear into it and the rest is on top so for long listening it may hurt the ears. But not horrible. Sound was good! surprisingly so. not audiophile of course but decent. and a big step up from listening on notebook speakers. the built in mic I have yet to try and havent tried noise canceling which there doesn't appear to be a switch for so another negative. I think the better ones are 60 bucks and dont fold . so for some basics for travel these are good. I have a even tinier super light headphone thats bluetooth but not noise canceling for airplanes so my dec for these was def for airlines. I will report back after i fly.Loudness - these get VERY LOUD! Bass - These have excellent BASS Vocals - decent to good not audiophile. Listened to bowie ashes to ashes on amazon music and was quite balanced. Headphone sizing - bands CLICK to positions. very good. Plugging in the USB-B charger mini jack - a huge pain. Has a micro SD slot. I think they would benefit from a audio graphic equalizer to rebalance."
				text 'Anglebert Dinkherhump'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'just what I was looking for'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text 'I love my gym. I really, really do. But the owner BLASTS music that is...ummm...not so great for lifting. I mean, Elvis? He keeps the volume up loud enough that even with my in-ear headphones on so loud it physically hurt, I could still hear the gym music over my own. So then it was like, my music clashing with "American Pie," which basically meant a headache every single day. So I wanted to get some (inexpensive) noise-canceling headphones to see if I could solve the problem, and these did the trick. I now listen to my own music (and ONLY my own!) at a reasonable volume. The fact that they fold for easier storage in my gym bag is a bonus.'
				text 'JGonzo'
				time '4/20/23'
				text 'Yeah so what that they are cheaply priced but they are worth it for kids and zoom meetings.'
				LayoutTable
					LayoutTableRow '| Rating 100 |'
				text 'Now for being cheap no name brand it works perfectly for the kids during zoom meetings for school. It has blue tooth and headphone jack so when the battery is low they can still use the provided wire to hear the meeting. Now I will say this. The microphone works plugged in to the head jack or Bluetooth but for it picking up the kids voice it has a hard time if they are talking in a low voice. They almost have to speak up for the microphone to hear them talking or it kinda cuts in and out. But for the price and quality and because I’m tired of loaning my kids my Bose and Powerbeats pro headphones for the meetings they work perfectly for what they need. Would definitely buy these again. For small ears the padding goes over their ears. It won’t go over mine as I’m an adult with adult sized ears ???? lol. But the kids really like them. I have them in red black. Blue black.
